title: One More Chair
origin: Original fictional scenario, not a representation of Amanda or Hannah's workbook.

setup.line: Rain brings the last students into the repair café. Closing time: 6:00.

setup.speaker: Inez
setup.line: Three booked repairs left. The hall must be clear at six. I'll finish the lamp.

setup.speaker: Sam
setup.line: My bag split on the way here. I start my placement tomorrow. Could you help?

setup.speaker: Bo
setup.line: I can stitch that. But I'm already repairing this umbrella. We promised its owner five-fifty.

setup.speaker: Ren
setup.line: If we take one more, something else has to move. We can't promise everyone the same minutes.

actions.label: Pull in the spare chair
actions.description: Take the bag now; redistribute the work.

actions.label: Offer the return-slot box
actions.description: Protect today's bookings; arrange a specific next step.

extend.speaker: Ren
extend.line: Bo, take the bag. I'll finish the umbrella. Inez, please tell me if the lamp slips.

extend.speaker: Bo
extend.line: The needle goes back through the same hole. Slowly. I'll show you once.
5:58. The bag is mended. The umbrella's final seam is not.

extend.speaker: Ren
extend.line: I took on work I couldn't finish in time. I'm sorry. May I finish it with you outside, or arrange a collection tomorrow?

extend.speaker: Inez
extend.line: Next time, let's count the hands as well as the chairs.

return.speaker: Ren
return.line: We can't stitch it properly before closing. Let's find a real next step, not just send you away.

return.speaker: Inez
return.line: The library lends carry bags until eight. We can reserve tomorrow's first repair slot. Would those help?

return.speaker: Sam
return.line: The loan bag gets me through tomorrow. I wish I'd come earlier. I'll take that slot.
5:57. The three booked repairs are ready. Sam leaves with an appointment, not a repaired bag.

return.speaker: Bo
return.line: We kept a promise. Let's also make the next café easier to reach before closing.
